name: float-play
description: A modern Chrome extension that enhances YouTube Picture-in-Picture with better playback controls.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.options.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.service-worker.config.mjs
scripts.e2e:install: pnpm --dir e2e install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright install chromium
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
